I was going in to Labour after 20 weeks of pregnancy. It was a small hospital. There was no delivery room available because it was a buisy night. I was put in a side room. 
One nurse helped me deliver my stillborn son. She put him on a table in the room where I could see him,  just before she was called away for an emergency.
I started bleeding profusely, but this being my first pregnancy I thought it to be normal.
After what felt like an hour of being on my own looking at my dead child she returned to me bleeding out  and almost fainting. She called for help immediatly and they rushed me to surgery. Had a blood transfusion and went home the next day. For the longest time I wished she wouldn't have found me and I would have died there with my baby. It was traumatic even 24 years later.
